figurative_meaning_en: Presenting simple or colloquial language in formal, Sanskritized Bengali
example_sentences_in_english: His writing shows a tendency towards gourd-tiger phrasing.
This book is filled with examples of gourd-tiger expressions.
history: Refers to the historical linguistic practice in Bengali of elevating colloquial terms to formal Sadhu Bhasha using Sanskrit-derived words, common in 19th-20th century literature.
note: The idiom highlights the contrast between Cholito (colloquial) and Sadhu (formal) forms of Bengali.
